n: Café 1.9 Cu. Ft. Over-the-range Microwave Oven
desc: The Cafe 1.9 Cu. Ft. Over-the-Range Microwave Oven is the ideal microwave for cooking anything from a quick breakfast to an elaborate dinner party meal. With customizable over-the-range handle and stainless steel appearance, this microwave will elevate your kitchen's style while providing a variety of helpful features.
hl: This large microwave helps you quickly cook big dishes for family meals.
Choose from four over-the-range microwave venting options to eliminate smoke, grease, steam and odors from your kitchen, all with just the touch of one button
This 400-CFM over-the-range microwave provides recirculating venting or external venting to remove smoke, grease, odors and steam from your kitchen.
Choose from four handle color options, including Brushed Bronze, Brushed Stainless, Brushed Copper and Brushed Black to create a look that matches your style for a one-of-a-kind kitchen design
This microwave uses sensor cooking to eliminate guesswork when it comes to reheating leftovers, monitoring food temps so meals are always warmed to the perfect temperature.
Make it easier to thaw frozen foods in the microwave with this setting, which automatically sets the best defrost time based on the weight of the food.
